thread.title: Exclusive-Sen. Tommy Tuberville: Pete Hegseth Isn't the Hero We Deserve, But the Hero We Need
thread.title_full: Exclusive-Sen. Tommy Tuberville: Pete Hegseth Isn't the Hero We Deserve, But the Hero We Need

author: Chris
text:
There seems to be a disconnect from what Hegseth, Tuberville, and MAGA perceives the military and what it actually is.
Hegseth's focus on combat training, getting fit, and not lowering the standards for women is noteworthy. However, those role is only a tiny fraction of the military.
Enter the Democrat's and DEI. Support roles should be a cross-section of America and it is. That includes all the people that Hegseth and MAGA do not like.
Not everyone in the military can be fighter pilots. They all cannot be Navy Seals. Green Berets. Delta Force. Marines. TACPs.
We have a hard ENOUGH time recruiting for those combat roles...it would be IMPOSSIBLE to have the same standard for the cook, medic, logistics, and other very VALUABLE roles in our Defense Department that makes us the best equipped, best trained, and best fighting force in the world.
In reality, the fitness of service members....ACROSS MULTIPLE PRESIDENTIAL ADMINISTRATIONS...have maintained the needed physical fitness requirements.
Democrats, on the other hand, push DEI way too much. This is a much needed course correction, however, Heseth's leadership is not going over well with the majority of service members. MAGA might say "who cares", but you cannot fight a war without the #1 logistics organization in the world.
So we need to meet in the middle a little bit. We need to purge the branches of military who are NOT maintaining good physical fitness, but we got to calm down on the anti-women in the military rhetoric and the fact that everyone is not in a combat role.
